content.short: NiftyKit provides a fully no-code UI for audited NFT smart contracts deployed on Ethereum.
content.description: NiftyKit gives creators a comprehensive, user-friendly toolkit to launch an NFT drop or collection across supported networks. The platform covers essential needs with a streamlined workflow, from configuring revenue sharing to setting token gating, so campaigns can be set up in just a few clicks. With thoroughly audited smart contracts, NiftyKit provides the security and reliability creators expect, empowering them to bring their next digital project to life with confidence, control, and clarity.
